spec.question: We are reviewing a lexer simplification: replace the dedicated SQL_REGEX rule that recognizes END together with an optional IF, LOOP, WHILE, FOR, or CASE suffix with a rule recognizing only the standalone word END. Leave every other regex, keyword dictionary, and pipeline stage unchanged, so a suffix is subsequently processed by the remaining lexical rules. Which currently passing tests in this snapshot would newly fail? Return only a JSON list of their complete pytest node IDs, including parameter IDs.
